messages:
maria: promo stuck during CI prefetch; deploy-bot keeps hitting cache-service 504s. change window open, need quick call.
kevin: saw it too. prefetch retries look like `attempt 6/10` then backoff. artifacts exist in registry, only cache fetch failing.

deploy-bot: automated: promotion request promo-67890 triggered by maria at 1717810000. state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=6/10 last_error=504 Gateway Timeout.

sam-oncall: investigating cache-service. frontends report long-running s3 proxy connections, thread count rising. scaling doesn't help immediately.

jonas: options: 1) abort promo and rollback, 2) manual promote pinned digest and skip prefetch, 3) wait for infra fix (time-limited, window ends in ~25m).

olivia: leaning to manual promote with skip-prefetch so we don't waste change window. ensure we have rollback plan and smoke checks.

kevin: deploy-bot has `--skip-cache-prefetch` flag for manual promotions; we tested on staging earlier today. I can run `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:0f1e2d3c4b --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21` if infra signs off.

maria: approve if we do immediate smoke and a short canary (2% traffic for 30m). also add rollback instructions in release notes.

sam-oncall: infra will also attempt an incremental restart of the s3-proxy pool. i'll restart nodes one at a time; will report health metrics. reopening cache incident INC-2026-03-cache-18.

kevin: kicking manual promote now. command executed, job promo-67891 queued.

deploy-bot: update: promo-67891 started. stage=artifact_activation -> in-progress. note: prefetch skipped by flag.

deploy-bot: success: promo-67891 completed. prod image=sha256:0f1e2d3c4b. tag=manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21. label=manual_promo

maria: starting smoke tests and canary traffic routing. watching errors and p95 latency.

olivia: i'll add a short release note: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch 504s; promoted sha256:0f1e2d3c4b; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target: sha256:b4c3d2e1f0."

kevin: release notes and rollback playbook updated. support on pager.

sam-oncall: s3-proxy restart seems to have reduced 504s from 20% -> 1.5% over 2m. team will follow up with postmortem; possible connection leak.

jonas: good call. follow-ups: 1) add circuit-breaker to deploy-bot prefetch so it can fall back automatically, 2) document `--skip-cache-prefetch` usage, 3) postmortem for cache-service.

maria: pinning this thread into the release doc and closing the promo hold. thanks all. will monitor full 30m canary then unpin.

olivia: closing note: change window record updated and incident linked. :white_check_mark:
